For R4 : Mr.Su.Srinivasan,
 Standing Counsel  ORDER
The petitioner herein seeks a direction to the first respondent to pass an arbitration award on the petitioner's appeal dated 12.04.2022 within the specific period of time fixed by this Court.

2. According to the petitioner, the property situated at https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Odayandahalli Village, Denkanikottai Taluk, Krishnagiri district, measuring an extentof 177sq.mtrs,
in S.No.53/5, 815 Sq.Mtrs in s.No.54/2 and 450 Sq.Mtrs. in S.No.172/3 were acquired by the second respondent for the purpose of laying four -way Road - Hosur - Rayakottai - Dharmapuri under N.H.844 project.

The competent authority /second respondent fixed the quantum of compensation and the petitioner not satisfied with the quantum of compensation, filed a claim petition dated 12.04.2022, seeking enhancement of compensation and the same has been referred to arbitration before the first respondent.
Though the claim petition has been filed on 12.04.2024, no final order has been passed by the first respondent.
Hence the petitioner is before this court.
3. Mr.A.Selvendran, learned Special Government Pleader, who takes notice for the respondents 1 to 3 submitted that the claim petition will be considered on merits within the time fixed by this Court.
4. The first respondent is expected to adhere to the time schedule mentioned in Arbitration and Conciliation Act and he is not expected to keep arbitral proceedings pending without any progress.

5. In view of the same, this Court is inclined to issue a direction to the first respondent to consider the petitioner's claim petition dated https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 12.04.2022 and pass final Valliyappan vs The Arbitrator Cum District Collector on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115508709/
2 orders, within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
